listing.name: Fallout 2 (Fallout 2 Community Edition)
listing.summary: Use Fallout 2 Community Edition 1.3.0 in your own complete supported Windows game installation. Keep fallout2.cfg, original game files, music and every save location. You and upstream manage setup, updates and saved data; Portcove can register and launch the prepared player. Original-game rights and mod or save compatibility are separate requirements.

steps.title: Use the actual Community Edition player
steps.instruction: Keep a complete already permitted Fallout 2 Community Edition 1.3.0 Windows x64 copy and supported original Fallout 2 installation. Upstream documents fallout2-ce.exe as the drop-in player in that folder. Select it directly, not fallout2.exe, an installer or another mod engine. Native Windows entry owns the game loop and uses the shared GNW95MUTEX; another such running instance can prevent startup.

steps.title: Finish supported original setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use your own complete supported original game installation including master.dat/critter.dat/patch000.dat/data and other required files; keep the whole working game and data. Finish configuration and a normal upstream start/quit before registration. Restoration Project, EtTu and Olympus2207 are unsupported by the selected upstream contract; do not infer sfall features or compatibility for other mods. Portcove does not import or authenticate the original set or generated/private outputs.

steps.title: Retain the real working directory and configuration
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared game folder as working directory and preserve its supported literal arguments. Windows entry does not chdir for you. fallout2.cfg is located from the executable path while actual DAT/patch/music paths can be relative or absolute. Keep those real paths and selected mod setup; do not rewrite a host root or force a fresh profile. Review exact consent and choose Play separately.

steps.title: Retain the engine license and original rights separately
steps.instruction: The selected engine uses Sustainable Use License 1.0, not GPL/MIT. Personal/noncommercial/internal-business scope, free noncommercial distribution conditions and notices remain applicable. This guide adds no general commercial, original/mod asset, repackaging or redistribution grant; attach only a copy you are already permitted to use.

steps.title: Update the game and remove its registration
steps.instruction: Close every running copy before changing external files. You manage setup, game replacement, profile changes, data migration and recovery. Keep the working game version and every data folder, update it with the project’s tools, then review and select the changed executable before choosing Play. Portcove monitors only the process you selected and agreed to launch. It does not prevent other copies from running, restrict file access or take over unrelated helpers or replacement processes. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. This route does not offer Portcove downloads, setup, updates, backups, rollback, data migration or deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. These instructions do not establish permission for the original game or other components, or confirm the resulting game files.
These instructions do not confirm gameplay, saving, mods, network play, physical controls or behavior on other platforms.
Before updating the game, keep a recoverable copy of its working files and every location containing saved data. Another game folder may use the same profile.
Preserve the old creating copy before upstream replacement. Another runtime folder is not a save/instance isolation or cross-version state-compatibility guarantee.

references.title: Preserve every actual player-data root
references.instruction: Keep the complete runtime/original data, fallout2.cfg, actual configured master-patches root (normally data) and its SAVEGAME/SLOT contents, music, mods, logs and unknowns, including configured external/legacy roots. Preserve the old creating copy before upstream replacement. Another runtime folder is not a save/instance isolation or cross-version state-compatibility guarantee.
